record.content: 2010 overview western panel, corroborated by lake detail maps and named USFS trail features: 20E98 branches south from 20E16 and passes the east side of Gem Lake. Segmentation at source breaks and chosen trail approach vertices is descriptive, not a claim of an official named junction. No atomic mileage assigned from cumulative reports or GIS lengths.
